nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; agents must read bundled docs before coding. Block is auto-regenerated by next dev, so commit it to keep tree clean.

nodes.label: Offline fallback page
nodes.rationale: Shown when offline; pass and check-ins need internet.

nodes.label: Arena Red on Ink design
nodes.rationale: Colours from the logo (#E3141C red, plate shades, ink, chalk); Anton display, Barlow text.

nodes.label: Star's Gym logo
nodes.rationale: Red and white wordmark 'STAR'S GYM' over a red barbell with a flexing bodybuilder silhouette; bold sporty identity

nodes.label: Brand palette: red #E3141B-ish on near-black, white type
nodes.norm_label: brand palette: red #e3141b-ish on near-black, white type
nodes.rationale: High-contrast red on black matches the logo and is used on every CTA.

nodes.label: Streak wall (attendance gamification)
nodes.rationale: Hero copy says 'climb the streak wall', which suggests a leaderboard of members ranked by check-in streak.

nodes.label: Home screen PWA store screenshot (mobile)
nodes.rationale: Portrait phone screenshot for the PWA manifest/install sheet. It shows the public marketing landing page, not the admin dashboard.

nodes.label: Primary 'Book a Trial Day' and secondary 'See Plans' buttons
nodes.norm_label: primary 'book a trial day' and secondary 'see plans' buttons
nodes.rationale: Clear primary/secondary hierarchy: a filled red button for the trial (the low-commitment entry) and an outlined button for browsing membership plans.

nodes.label: Header: Stars Gym logo, Join Now pill CTA, hamburger menu
nodes.norm_label: header: stars gym logo, join now pill cta, hamburger menu
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first layout: the nav collapses into a hamburger and only the main conversion action (Join Now) stays visible.

nodes.label: Hero: 'STARS GYM' solid/outline display type, 'Earn your star.' tagline over gym photo
nodes.norm_label: hero: 'stars gym' solid/outline display type, 'earn your star.' tagline over gym photo
nodes.rationale: Bold, athletic brand look: condensed display type, dark photo overlay, and a red accent on the word 'STAR' as a pun on the brand name. Copy names both branches (Mandadam & Tadepalli) and the three core flows: buy online, check in at the door, and the streak wall.

nodes.label: Live branch open/closed status ticker with Check In link
nodes.norm_label: live branch open/closed status ticker with check in link
nodes.rationale: The top strip shows 'CLOSED - Tadepalli opens 16:00' and cycles between branches, so visitors see real-time hours. 'CHECK IN' gives members a quick way into door check-in.

nodes.label: Streak wall / online purchase + door check-in
nodes.norm_label: streak wall / online purchase + door check-in
nodes.rationale: Copy 'Buy online, check in at the door, climb the streak wall' summarizes core product loop: membership purchase, attendance check-in, gamified streak leaderboard

nodes.label: Wide PWA screenshot (landing hero)
nodes.rationale: Desktop/wide form-factor store screenshot for the PWA manifest, showcasing the public landing hero

nodes.label: Book a Trial Day / See Plans CTAs
nodes.norm_label: book a trial day / see plans ctas
nodes.rationale: Solid red primary and outlined secondary CTA pairing for trial booking vs plan browsing

nodes.label: Stars Gym landing hero
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed dark gym photo with huge condensed 'STARS GYM' (solid + outline) and 'EARN YOUR STAR.' tagline in red accent; dark/red brand palette conveys strength

nodes.label: Top navigation (Trainers, Personal Training, Gallery, Contact, Sign In, Join Now)
nodes.norm_label: top navigation (trainers, personal training, gallery, contact, sign in, join now)
nodes.rationale: Primary red pill CTA 'Join Now' contrasted with ghost 'Sign In' to prioritize conversion

nodes.label: Live open/closed status bar
nodes.rationale: Top strip shows CLOSED and 'Tadepalli opens 16:00' plus a CHECK IN link, surfacing real-time branch hours and door check-in

nodes.label: plans table (tracks x durations, trial, day pass)
nodes.norm_label: plans table (tracks x durations, trial, day pass)

nodes.label: SQL-enforced money and streak rules (security-definer + RLS)
nodes.norm_label: sql-enforced money and streak rules (security-definer + rls)
nodes.rationale: Rules live in SQL so the browser cannot skip them; early renewal queues the new plan after the current one ends.

nodes.label: Pass ticket (/pass/[id], rotating QR, next/og PNG)
nodes.norm_label: pass ticket (/pass/[id], rotating qr, next/og png)
nodes.rationale: QR re-signs every 30s so screenshots go stale.

nodes.norm_label: pay at desk (/pay/[id] upi qr + mark paid)

nodes.label: check_in()
nodes.rationale: Requires active plan, branch open hours, optional geofence (require_location), once per day.

nodes.label: current_streak()
nodes.rationale: Days when every branch is closed are skipped so streaks are not broken.

nodes.label: Plans Screenshot (PWA store, mobile)
nodes.rationale: PWA store screenshot showcasing the public membership pricing section on a phone viewport; dark theme with red accent and condensed display type for a bold gym brand feel.

nodes.label: Plan Duration Tabs (Monthly/Quarterly/6 Months/Yearly)
nodes.rationale: Segmented control with per-duration savings (13%/22%/30%) and a BEST VALUE badge on Yearly to nudge longer commitments; matches plans running by calendar months.

nodes.label: Site Header (Stars Gym logo, Join Now CTA, menu)
nodes.norm_label: site header (stars gym logo, join now cta, menu)
nodes.rationale: Persistent red pill 'Join Now' CTA keeps signup one tap away; hamburger menu for mobile nav. Brand: Stars Gym - The Fitness Arena.

nodes.label: Membership Section '02 - Pick Your Plan'
nodes.rationale: Numbered section eyebrow (02 MEMBERSHIP) plus oversized headline gives editorial, step-like page structure.

nodes.label: Plan Track Card (Track 01 Strength, Rs 1,499/month)
nodes.rationale: Horizontally scrollable track cards (next card peeks at right edge) with big INR price and checkmark feature list (free weights & machines, daily check-in & streaks).

Red-on-white with a distressed texture, bold stencil-like sans type, reads as energetic and strength-focused.
